steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F). Brush 8 cups of a muffin tin with the olive oil.
Grate the zucchini and squeeze it dry in a clean towel. Chop the spinach finely.
In a bowl, beat the eggs with the cow's milk until no streaks of white remain.
Stir in the zucchini, the spinach and the grated cheddar.
Divide between the 8 cups, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake 16 to 18 minutes, until puffed, set in the centre and lightly golden at the edges.
Cool 5 minutes, then run a knife around each one. Under 12 months, cut into strips. Keeps 3 days; freezes 1 month.
